{=str_coop_clan_other_families}Other Families
{=str_coop_clan_player_leader}Player · Clan leader
{=str_coop_clan_player_self}{ROLE} (You)
{=str_coop_clan_party_leader_only}Only the clan leader can manage clan parties.
{=str_coop_clan_party_roles_owner_only}Only this party's leader can assign its roles.
{=str_coop_clan_player_party_protected}Player parties cannot be disbanded or have their leaders replaced.
{=str_coop_clan_player_party_wages_disabled}Wage limits cannot be set for player parties.
{=str_coop_clan_identity_leader_only}Only the clan leader can change the clan's name or banner.
{=str_coop_clan_join_title}Join {CLAN_NAME}?
{=str_coop_clan_join_description}You are asking to join {CLAN_NAME}, led by {LEADER_NAME}. The clan leader will manage the shared clan and its assets.
{=str_coop_clan_join_companions}Companions: {COUNT}
{=str_coop_clan_join_workshops}Workshops: {COUNT}
{=str_coop_clan_join_caravans}Caravans: {COUNT}
{=str_coop_clan_join_parties}NPC clan parties: {COUNT}
{=str_coop_clan_join_alleys}Alleys: {COUNT}
{=str_coop_clan_join_supporters}Supporters: {COUNT}

{=str_coop_clan_join_forfeit_warning}On joining the clan, you give up ownership and control of the companions, assets and supporters listed above to the new clan leader. They will not be returned to you if you leave the clan later.
{=str_coop_clan_join_confirm}Send join request
{=str_coop_clan_offer_services_shared_leader}You cannot offer services while leading a clan with other players.
{=str_coop_clan_join_other_players}You cannot join another clan while other players belong to your clan.
{=str_coop_clan_join_target_not_leader}You must speak to the clan leader to request membership.
{=str_coop_clan_join_rules_kingdom}You cannot join another clan while ruling a kingdom.
{=str_coop_clan_join_mercenary}You must end your mercenary contract before joining another clan.
{=str_coop_clan_join_vassal}You must leave your current kingdom before joining another clan.
{=str_coop_clan_join_owns_fiefs}You cannot join another clan while your clan owns any fiefs.
{=str_coop_clan_join_incompatible_wars}Your clan is at war with a faction that the other clan is not at war with. Make peace first.
{=str_coop_clan_leave_dialogue}I am leaving the clan.
{=str_coop_clan_remove_player_dialogue}You are no longer a member of this clan.
{=str_coop_clan_player_left}The player has left the clan.
{=str_coop_clan_player_removed}The player has been removed from the clan.
{=str_coop_marriage_propose}I would like to propose marriage.
{=str_coop_marriage_choose}What kind of marriage do you propose?
{=str_coop_marriage_patrilineal}Patrilineal: the husband leads and the wife joins his clan.
{=str_coop_marriage_matrilineal}Matrilineal: the wife leads and the husband joins her clan.
{=str_coop_marriage_patrilineal_request}I propose a patrilineal marriage. (The wife joins the husband's clan, and he remains its leader)
{=str_coop_marriage_matrilineal_request}I propose a matrilineal marriage. (The husband joins the wife's clan, and she remains its leader)
{=str_coop_marriage_ineligible}These heroes are not currently eligible for marriage. Both must be unmarried, of marriageable age, of opposite sexes and not close relatives.
{=str_coop_marriage_hostile}You cannot propose marriage while hostile.
{=str_coop_marriage_clan_unavailable}The designated leader must already lead their clan, and the joining spouse must meet the clan-joining requirements. Both heroes must remain eligible for marriage.
{=str_coop_marriage_accept}Accept proposal
{=str_coop_marriage_accepted}Marriage proposal accepted.
{=str_coop_marriage_declined}Marriage proposal declined.
{=str_coop_marriage_proposal_title}Propose marriage to {LEADER_NAME}?
{=str_coop_marriage_proposal_description}You are proposing marriage to {LEADER_NAME}. If they accept, you will join {CLAN_NAME}. They will remain clan leader and manage its shared assets.
{=str_coop_marriage_acceptance_title}Accept marriage proposal?
{=str_coop_marriage_acceptance_description}If you accept {LEADER_NAME}'s marriage proposal, you will marry them and join {CLAN_NAME}. They will remain clan leader and manage its shared assets.
{=str_coop_marriage_clan_commitment}While married to another player, you cannot leave the clan or be removed from it.
